summary.zh: SOXX 盘前涨 1.8%，博通涨 3.2%、美光涨 2.3%、英伟达涨 1.1%，亚洲（SK 海力士涨 5.2%、爱德万涨 9%）和欧洲半导体股同步走强，纳指期货涨 0.5%，延续周一因 Anthropic 提交上市申请带来的反弹。RSI 仅 21、指数较高点回落 24%，开盘后小幅继续修复；统计模型预计开盘后微跌 0.1%，我略偏多，合计预测上涨 2.0%。明天美联储议息和大型科技股财报可能使午后观望。
summary.en: SOXX is up 1.8% pre-market, led by Broadcom (+3.2%), Micron (+2.3%) and Nvidia (+1.1%), with Asian and European chip stocks also strong and Nasdaq futures +0.5%, extending Monday's Anthropic-IPO rebound. With RSI at 21 and the index 24% off its high I lean slightly positive after the open, versus the model's -0.1, for +2.0%. The Fed and big-tech earnings tomorrow may cap afternoon buying.

factors.zh: 亚洲与欧洲半导体走强：SK 海力士 +5.18%、爱德万 +8.98%、BESI +9.29%
factors.en: Asia and Europe chips strong: SK Hynix +5.18%, Advantest +8.98%, BESI +9.29%

factors.zh: RSI(14) 仅 21，较高点回落 24.3%，超卖反弹延续
factors.en: RSI(14) at 21, 24.3% below the high: oversold bounce can extend

factors.zh: 昨日已涨 2.82%，统计模型预计开盘后 -0.1%（获利回吐）
factors.en: SOX already +2.82% yesterday; the model sees -0.1% after the open

factors.zh: AI 债务担忧未消，周三美联储决议与微软、Meta 财报在即
factors.en: AI debt worries persist; Fed decision and Microsoft/Meta earnings on Wednesday

risk.zh: 若纳指期货转跌、博通/英伟达涨幅回吐，或 AI 债务担忧重燃，反弹会在开盘后迅速消退，收盘涨幅可能不足 1%。
risk.en: If Nasdaq futures turn down, Broadcom/Nvidia give back their gains, or AI-debt worries return, the rebound could fade after the open and the close could be under +1%.

views.en: Broadcom, AMD and Nvidia are higher pre-market on new AI-spending news, including a $63 billion financing deal tied to Anthropic and Nvidia's $3 billion investment in Meta's equity offering.
views.zh: 博通、AMD 和英伟达盘前上涨，原因是新的 AI 投入消息，包括与 Anthropic 相关的 630 亿美元融资以及英伟达向 Meta 股权发行投资 30 亿美元。

views.en: Stocks rose as Anthropic's IPO filing reignited the AI trade, but the rebound faces a busy week of big-tech earnings and a Fed decision.
views.zh: Anthropic 提交上市申请重新点燃 AI 交易，美股上涨，但这轮反弹要面对本周密集的大型科技股财报和美联储决议。

views.en: Chip stocks in Seoul rebounded on the Anthropic IPO filing, with Samsung and SK hynix both gaining.
views.zh: 首尔芯片股因 Anthropic 提交上市申请而反弹，三星和 SK 海力士均上涨。
